text:
jun: thinking about adding a "quota splitter" view in Console so customers can allocate a reserved monthly token budget across named routes (webhook, ingestion, realtime). Need SDK support to send per-request route allocation metadata so billing/quotas match what UI shows.
ashley: +1 from product — customers keep asking for finer quota control. how does this map to current routing headers?
matt: today we have X-Route-Tag and X-Cost-Center but neither carries split percentages. naive approach: send X-Quota-Split: web=60,ingest=30,rt=10. small, simple.
sophia: problem: headers can be clipped by proxies and we already have 8+ custom headers. also telemetry needs to attribute tokens by these splits for dashboard.
jun: two implementation options I sketched:
1) compact header: X-Quota-S: w60,i30,r10 (cheap)
2) base64 JSON header: X-Quota-Split: eyJ3ZWIiOjYwLCJpbmdlc3QiOjMwLCJydCI6MTB9 (verbose)
neal: infra-bot: Deploy check — headers > 256 bytes get dropped on some LB configs. So keep it tiny.
ashley: UX side: Console should show both the configured split and the observed effective split (from telemetry) so customers can see mismatches. we should plan a phased rollout (beta flag on per-customer).
matt: SDK changes: add optional param in client call like {quotaSplit: {web:0.6, ingest:0.3, realtime:0.1}} so languages can encode compact form automatically. Also fallback to last-known account-level split if header missing.
sophia: telemetry: we need a sampling + deterministic attribution mode so we can reconstruct token counts when SDKs don't send split. maybe hash-based sampling: if no header, map request id -> route by consistent hashing to avoid bias.
jun: open question: should the server accept both header encodings? Accepting both eases rollout but increases parsing surface. I prefer one stable compact form.
ashley: agree single canonical header. prefer readable ascii compact (w60,i30,r10). ops can grep easily.
neal: infra-bot: note: customers behind older proxies may rewrite commas -> semicolons. consider allowing both separators or URL-encoded value.
matt: SDK task list (rough): TS/Python/Go add field, encode as 'k<percent>' pairs, unit tests, e2e with Gateway to ensure header preserved, add opt-in feature flag toggle.
sophia: console work: add 'Quota splits' panel under Billing -> Routes; show configured vs observed; add warning when observed drift > 5%.
jun: rollout plan: feature flag in Console + SDK opt-in release (minor bump). self-serve customers get beta toggle; enterprise sales get assisted enablement. aim for Canary in 2 weeks.
ashley: +1. can someone draft the docs snippet for SDKs? quick example request + response for QA.
matt: I'll draft TS and Python snippets today. example TS: ```ts
const client = new RedwoodClient();
client.generate({prompt: 'x'}, {quotaSplit: {web:0.6, ingest:0.3, realtime:0.1}})
// header sent: X-Quota-S: w60,i30,r10
```
sophia: add a note in telemetry docs about how observed attribution is computed (header -> token attribution, else deterministic sampling).
neal: infra-bot: rolling this behind a feature flag + sending to staging priv-net for LB header passthrough test recommended.
jun: thanks — i'll open the RFC and link SDK PR template. ping @devex channel when drafts ready. 
ashley: thanks all :rocket:
